provider_event_id: condition_id (Polymarket market condition id) — exact, from source row
physical_event_id: composite (condition_id, selected_token_id) dedup key — PARTIAL, provider-level proxy, not independently canonicalized
game_start_iso: diagnostics.gameStartIso where present — PARTIAL coverage, NULL otherwise
sport_family: derived from diagnostics.marketType via frozen keyword map — PARTIAL, UNKNOWN where marketType absent
lead_time_minutes: derived: (game_start_iso - selected_source_created_at) in minutes, only where game_start_iso present — PARTIAL
settlement_label: generated_signal_pairs.signal_result (WIN/LOSS/other/NULL) mapped to WIN/LOSS/AMBIGUOUS/UNRESOLVED — exact, no fuzzy matching
source_cohort: derived from selected_source_created_at against mission-specified EARLY/RECOVERED/MAIN windows — exact
identity_quality: EXACT where game_start_iso present, else PARTIAL_NO_GAME_START
